purpose.summary: Compact context for Media Face Organizer, conversion/ingest, organization, and SpiritFlix 3001 lane.
purpose.reason: Avoid requiring a whole repomix for the next model while preserving the important decisions, paths, and live truth.

routeBehavior.item: Enrolled and enrollment queue routes serve static files instead of regenerating on GET.
Static files stream in chunks with Content-Length and no-store cache header.
Generated images use loading="lazy" and decoding="async".
Video match rows use responsive layout to prevent narrow-panel text collapse.

matchingBehavior.item: Metadata collection resolves stale sidecars to actual video paths.
Duplicate sidecars for the same resolved video are deduped; the sidecar with strongest real face evidence wins.
Rows without supporting faces/crops/frames do not count as face-rec auto or review matches.
Run face-rec scan for this model targets linked model videos instead of blindly scanning first N videos in source root.

latestSavaTruth.summary: Targeted scan of Sava Schultz linked videos scanned 11 videos: 6 strong matches, 2 review-level matches, 3 not matched.

doNotMisstate.item: Do not say 6513 is confirmed Sava by face recognition; it detected faces but similarity was too low.
Do not treat metadata/manual/OCR-only rows as face-rec confidence.
Do not assume SpiritFlix visible counts and organizer source counts must match; Jellyfin exposure can lag or differ.
